About Me

A little about myself and what drives me

AI Workflow & Automation Specialist

Hi, I’m Mike. I design AI-assisted workflows, automation systems, and operational tools that help organizations reduce manual work, improve coordination, and create better user experiences.

My background spans higher education, academic libraries, technical training, and customer-facing operational environments. Over the years, I’ve developed instructional resources, digital learning systems, research support tools, and workflow processes focused on accessibility, usability, and practical problem-solving.

More recently, I’ve focused on building AI-powered workflow systems using tools such as Make, Zapier, Airtable, OpenAI, and low-code development platforms. My work includes intake automations, AI-assisted support systems, operational dashboards, and rapid prototypes designed to streamline repetitive tasks and improve day-to-day workflows.

What interests me most is practical AI implementation — using AI thoughtfully to solve operational problems, support learning, improve communication, and make systems easier for people to use.
